name: Bennett Industries Of Tennessee, Inc.
old_description: Bennett Industries is proud to offer multiple services within the Metal Worx realm. We focus but are not limited to custom fabrication, metal sales, small and large-scale productions, CNC cutting, precision machining, and stamping.
about:
Bennett Industries of Tennessee, Inc. operates a 46,000-square-foot facility on a five-acre industrial campus at 2299 Summerfield Road in Cookeville, Tennessee. The company has served the region for over fifty years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company provides six integrated service lines—Metal Worx, Powder Worx, Fab Worx, Machine Worx, Blast Worx, and Awning Worx—covering custom fabrication, metal sales, CNC cutting, precision machining, stamping, welding, sandblasting, restoration, powder coating, and awning production. Its facility supports both small- and large-scale production runs.

Bennett Industries serves manufacturers, contractors, DIY enthusiasts, and the general public, supplying metal products and fabrication services across a broad customer base.

The company emphasizes "highest integrity services" and positions itself as a single-source provider capable of handling most any manufacturing need, from raw material supply through finishing and assembly.
